system.name: AdvDM
system.one_liner: Adversarial examples for diffusion models that protect artworks from imitation by corrupting the feature (condition) the model extracts from an image.

content.variant_note: two titled bands (classifier, generative model), each with a green clean lane above a red adversarial lane; the lower band adds a grey zoom box on the extract step
content.argues: Adversarial examples for diffusion models corrupt the extracted condition, giving an out-of-distribution condition and a broken generated image, as a wrong label does for classifiers.
content.subject: A clean and an adversarial cat photo through a classifier, and through condition extraction and generation in a diffusion model.

encoding.color_means: Green = clean image and the in-distribution case (frame, tall bar, check, star, letter c); red = adversarial example and the out-of-distribution case (frame, short bar, cross, star, letter c); grey = models and the condition region.
encoding.line_style_means: Solid black arrows carry data; the dashed black arrow is the extract step; the thin green dashed line ties the clean image to the zoom box; curved coloured arrows put the condition into the prompt.
encoding.shape_means: Grey rectangles = models; grey dome-shaped region = where conditions of real images lie; stars = condition points; rounded grey box = detail of the extract step; curly braces = stages.
encoding.marker_means: Check and cross = correct or wrong outcome; t = 0 and t = T = ends of the noising chain; braces name the condition stage and the generation stage.
encoding.emphasis: The red lane differs from the green lane only by input, so the effects stand out: short red bar, cross, star outside the grey region and a distorted output.

new_tags.name: green-red-paired-lanes
new_tags.what: the same pipeline drawn twice, a green lane for the clean or good case and a red lane for the attacked or failing case, with frames, bars, marks and text slots all following the lane colour

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw the clean and the attacked case as two lanes through the same model and colour everything that belongs to a lane (photo frame, bar, tick or cross, star, even the slot letter in the prompt) green or red, ending the red lane in a visibly broken output. Add one grey zoom box above the stage that needs explaining.
lessons.suits: Robustness, attack or safety papers that contrast a clean and a perturbed input through one pipeline and must show the failure on a sample.

evidence: This workflow consists of two stages: (1) the condition stage that extracts the feature from input images as conditions
Our adversarial examples work by misleading the feature extracting in the condition stage and resulting in an out-of-distribution condition.

summary: AdvDM builds adversarial examples for diffusion models so that artists can stop unauthorised painting imitation. Figure 1 compares workflows in two stacked bands. The top band shows the classic case: a clean cat photo (green frame) is classified “cat” with a tall green bar and a check, its adversarial copy (red frame) “dog” with a short red bar and a cross. The lower band shows a diffusion model in two stages: condition extraction by textual inversion, expanded in a grey box with forward and reverse noising strips and the objective, then generation from the prompt “A photo of c”. The green lane gives a good cat image, the red lane an out-of-distribution condition (red star outside the grey region) and a distorted image.
summary_zh: AdvDM 为扩散模型构造对抗样本，防止他人模仿画作。图 1 分上下两带：上带是分类器，干净猫图被判为 cat，对抗图被判为 dog；下带是扩散模型的条件提取与生成两阶段，灰色框展开文本反演，绿线生成正常图，红线得到分布外条件和失真图。
notes: The pre-screen listed two panels; they are kept as two titled bands. The grey textual-inversion box is tied to the extract step by a curly brace and a green dashed leader, recorded as zoom_callout 'other'. The digest counts 17 placed bitmaps; 16 visible tiles are listed (one frame of the forward strip is placed twice, once for its green frame).
